outcome_verbatim: A total of 68 participants were assigned to the IPS program, of whom of 51 (75%) obtained competitive work in the study, which comprised the sample for the present paper
source_locator: Method 2.1 Participants, p. 313
notes: The only extractable employment result in this report. outcome_verbatim: Three items from the SURF (ie, Are you currently a student? Have you worked for pay during the past 30 days? Have you done any casual work or day jobs, such as yard work or babysitting for which you got paid?) were combined into a single score to measure work or school functioning at each assessment point (ie, the past month) and aggregated across 6-month time points; each was rated as either 0 = no (ie, no paid work and not a student) or 1 = yes (ie, paid work or a student)
source_locator: Table 1, Outcome variables, 'SURF work or school 6 mo 71.8%', p. 371; measure defined in Measures, Occupational Functioning, p. 371
notes: NUMERATOR NOT RECOVERABLE. Table 1 prints only a percentage for the SURF work-or-school variable. It is not back-calculated, and in this case a back-calculation would not even be arithmetically possible: 39.8% at baseline is not n/404 for any integer n, which is consistent with the measure being a composite of three items aggregated across 6-month blocks, so the printed value is the mean of an aggregated score rather than a stated proportion of participants. outcome_construct is paid_or_education, not paid_any: the item set counts being a student as a positive, and it names no training component, so it is neither the primary construct nor the full EET composite. ascertainment_window_months = 1 records the measurement window the report states for each assessment, 'the past month'; the report then says the score was 'aggregated across 6-month time points', so the reported value is an aggregate of six such windows rather than a single month, and it should not be treated as a clean one-month period prevalence. missing_data_method is recorded as complete_case for these descriptive percentages; the structural equation models used full information maximum likelihood, which the controlled vocabulary has no value for. Baseline was 39.8% on the same measure. 6 months falls in no prespecified landmark band.
